FS-iA6B при потере связи с пультом НЕ пе: On link loss the FS-iA6B does NOT stop sending iBUS — it keeps sending the last values (tested on the bench: transmitter off, frames keep coming at 130/s). So the timeout above only catches a broken wire or a dead receiver; the receiver reports link loss with the failsafe value set in the transmitter: throttle (CH3) goes below the normal range (~900 µs, see docs/PILOT_GUIDE.md, "Setting up failsafe in the transmitter"). SBUS and CRSF report link loss themselves (a frame flag, LQ = 0); the throttle threshold works for them too if the receiver's failsafe is set to "throttle below normal".

Matek H743-WING V3, H743-WLITE, H743-SLIM V3 — a ready-made flight controller on the same STM32H743VIT6 as the DevEBox. The pinout follows the board description in ArduPilot (hwdef MatekH743) and the labels on the board; not yet tested on hardware.

Differences from the DevEBox: an 8 MHz crystal (src/stm32/clock_matek.cpp, HSE_VALUE in platformio.ini); the sensors are on the board itself — an ICM-42688-P IMU on SPI1, a DPS310 barometer on I2C2 (sensor kit SENSOR_KIT_MATEK_H743, set by the matek-h743 env); the external I2C1 connector (compass, pitot tube) is a separate bus. First flash: hold the BOOT button and plug in USB (DFU), after that — the 'D' key in the console.

Outputs follow the pad labels: S1 is the motor, S3–S8 are servos (both INAV and ArduPilot put the motor on S1). S1 and S2 are N channels of timer TIM1, the core enables them by itself. S2 (PB1) and S9–S12 (PD14, PD15, PE5, PE6) are free.

Runway auto takeoff (AUTO_TAKEOFF, autopilot/TakeoffController.h) — stages driven by the sensors, details in docs/AUTOPILOT_GUIDE.md. Pitch is measured from the ground calibration horizon (step 1), the parked attitude comes from step 2.

First a check: the plane is still for TAKEOFF_CHECK_MS and its angles match the parked ones within TAKEOFF_PARK_*_TOL_DEG (without a calibration — nose wheel only: tilt no more than TAKEOFF_UNCALIBRATED_TILT_DEG). Один сигнал — рули высоты и направления:
One signal: the elevator and rudder nod by SIGNAL_NOD_US (up and down for SIGNAL_NOD_MS) and, only when disarmed, the motor sings: pulses to the ESC stop for SIGNAL_ESC_PAUSE_MS, the ESC decides the signal is lost, and when the pulses (neutral) come back it plays its ready tune, as at power-up. The motor doesn't spin. Signals come every SIGNAL_PERIOD_MS so the tune can finish.

Count: 1 — calibration started / step accepted; 2 — done, saved; 3 — error, nothing saved (also auto takeoff refused at its check). A buzzer or LED on PIN_BUZZER is on for the duration of the nod.
Основной регулятор — BLHeli 80A, двунапр:
The main ESC is a BLHeli 80A, bidirectional: in BLHeliSuite it gets Motor Direction = "Bidirectional" (3D), throttle range 1000..2000. Then ESC_NEUTRAL_US (1500) means the motor is stopped, above is forward, below is reverse. Inside the firmware throttle is 1000..2000 = 0..100% everywhere (autopilot, telemetry, black box); it is converted to a 3D pulse only at the ESC output itself, taking the direction into account. "Motor off" (DISARM, failsafe, MOTOR_KILL) is therefore always 1500, not 1000: 1000 on a 3D ESC is full reverse.

A normal one-way ESC — ESC_BIDIRECTIONAL = false: throttle goes to the output as is (1000 = stop), reverse is unavailable.

Pitch slightly below the horizon — without the motor the plane keeps its speed and doesn't stall. Roll 0 — straight; 10-20 — a gentle circle, so the plane stays near the pilot instead of flying away in a straight line. If the plane is not armed (on the ground) or the IMU isn't responding, the surfaces simply go to neutral.

Прерванный взлёт на земле — мотор стоп,: Takeoff aborted on the ground — motor stops, elevator to neutral, heading and wings are held while it rolls: throttle stick below THROTTLE_LOW_US, link loss, IMU failure, bank over TAKEOFF_ABORT_ROLL_DEG, heading drift over TAKEOFF_ABORT_HEADING_DEG, nose below TD_MIN_PITCH_DEG, no liftoff within TAKEOFF_GROUND_TIMEOUT_MS. To retry — throttle down and up.
При отсутствии корректного кадра дольше: If no valid frame arrives for longer than this, the receiver is considered lost.

The easiest way is not to think about it: the 'o' command in the console (mounting calibration, 3 poses) works out how the board sits in the plane — at any angle, even upside down — and stores it in NVS. The value below is used only until there is such a calibration.

Rotation of the IMU CHIP axes relative to the plane around the vertical, clockwise when viewed from above (0/90/180/270): where the chip's own X axis points if the plane's nose is at "12 o'clock".
  0   — chip X axis to the nose
  90  — chip X axis to the right
  180 — chip X axis to the tail
  270 — chip X axis to the left
The board must lie chip up.

90 — for the current GY-521 (an MPU6500 clone) laid with the X arrow (on the silkscreen) toward the nose: the chip on it is soldered rotated, and the printed arrows don't match the chip axes (tested on the bench: X arrow up -> chip Y axis up, Y arrow up -> chip -X axis up). Check after any re-mounting: nose up -> pitch (P on the OLED) goes positive, right wing down -> roll (R) goes positive.

Сколько отсчётов (BMP581 — 50 в секунду): How many samples (BMP581 — 50 per second) to average for zero: the difference between the two barometers at zero airspeed.
Сколько стёртого места держать наготове: How much erased space to keep ready for the next flight. Erasing happens only on the ground while disarmed (on the ESP32 an erase stops both cores for ~0.15 s); old flights are erased whole, oldest first; the last recorded flight is never erased. Run short in the air — new data piles up in the queue and is written after landing.

Триммер записывается во флеш после DISAR: The trim is written to flash after DISARM, but only when the plane is standing still: on the ESP32 an NVS write stops both cores for ~0.4 s, and a DISARM in the air (the pilot cut the motor with the switch) must not freeze the surfaces. "Standing still" means near the ground by the barometer, almost no vertical speed, and slower than the threshold by the tube/GPS (no sensor — its condition isn't checked).
Тумблер ARM считается включённым выше эт: The ARM switch counts as on above this value.
Тумблер считается включённым выше этого: A switch counts as on above this value (on the FS-i6, down/toward you = 2000). Not 1500: until the first iBUS frame all channels default to 1500, and features (flaps, payload drop, RTH) must not turn on when the board powers up.
У ESP32-C3 всего 2 аппаратных UART (0 и: The ESP32-C3 has only 2 hardware UARTs (0 and 1) — UART2, which used to be hardcoded here, doesn't physically exist and crashed in gpsUart().begin(). UART1 is already taken by iBUS (rcSerial above), so GPS gets the only one left, UART0. Serial doesn't suffer: on the C3 it goes over USB-CDC (ARDUINO_USB_CDC_ON_BOOT in platformio.ini), not through the physical UART0.
Углы на разбеге: ускорение вперёд акселе: Angles on the takeoff run: the accelerometer takes forward acceleration for a raised nose (0.5 g is +27°). From motor start the horizon is tracked by the gyro only (its zero refined at the pre-start check) — until TAKEOFF_GYRO_ONLY_CLIMB_MS after the climb starts (acceleration is over), but no longer than TAKEOFF_GYRO_ONLY_MAX_MS; after an aborted takeoff — for TAKEOFF_GYRO_ONLY_ABORT_MS (the plane is braking).
Установка компаса — то же правило, что д: Compass mounting — the same rule as for the IMU: where the magnetometer chip's X axis points relative to the nose. Check on the assembled plane: turning the nose clockwise (seen from above) -> heading grows, nose to the north -> ~0°.
ФНЧ перепада, с. Барометры меряют не одн: Low-pass filter for the pressure difference, s. The barometers don't measure at the same moment; 0.1 s removes that noise and adds almost no lag for the autopilot.
Функции: направление самой функции, оста: Features: the direction of the feature itself, nothing else is touched.
Шаг 2 ждёт, пока самолёт переставят (дви: Step 2 waits until the plane is moved (motion after the signal), or CAL_PARK_WAIT_MS if the parked pose is the same as in step 1 (nose wheel).
